title: Write a parser
prompt: Implement parse_duration(text) in durations.py. It turns a duration into seconds: '1h30m' is 5400, '45s' is 45, '2h' is 7200, '1h2m3s' is 3723, and spaces between parts are allowed ('1h 30m'). Hours, minutes and seconds each appear at most once and in that order. Anything else (an empty string, a bare number like '10', an unknown unit like '5x', a repeated unit like '1h1h', a negative number) raises ValueError.
